head.description: Where the changes to merge are.

repo.description: The repository holding the branch: the target, or a fork.

main.description: For a private repository, written in the requester's repo inside the repository's space.

attachments.description: What it carries beside its body: the pictures the body shows. Kinds unknown to a reader are passed over, and kept by a client changing it.

base.description: The branch to merge into, without refs/heads/.

draft.description: Whether it is a draft: not ready to merge or queue. Its author clears it when it is ready. Not a draft, when absent.

facets.description: The accounts its body mentions, by where: written as it is, from each `@handle` outside code and links.

reverts.description: For a revert, the merged dev.knotless.pull it undoes, on the same repository, as `knotless pull revert` opens it. Readers count it only once this pull is merged.

reviewers.description: The accounts its author asks to review it. A maintainer asking someone else would need a record of their own, which this is not.

titleFacets.description: The accounts its title mentions, by where.

updatedAt.description: When its author last changed its title or body.

reviewer.description: An account a pull's author asks to review it.

requestedAt.description: When it was asked: when named, or when the pull was last marked ready, if that was later.

description: A request to merge a branch into a repository, kept in the requester's account.
